Creating an Account at Godz

Joining Godz Casino is designed to be a straightforward, highly secure process.

We have streamlined our registration procedure to allow Canadian players to open an account, verify their details, and access real-money games within minutes.

To register a new real-money account at Casino Godz, complete the following step-by-step procedure:

  1. Access Registration: Visit the official Godz website on your desktop or mobile device and select the "Sign Up" button located at the top right corner.

  2. Provide Account Information: Enter a valid email address, create a strong password, and select Canadian Dollars (CAD) as your account currency.

  3. Fill Out Personal Details: Enter your official full name, date of birth, mobile phone number, and residential Canadian postal address.

  4. Confirm Terms and Conditions: Read through our terms of service and privacy policy, confirm that you are of legal gambling age in your Canadian province, and complete the sign-up form.

  5. Account Verification (KYC): To ensure a smooth payout experience later, upload a valid government-issued photo ID (such as a Canadian driver's license or passport) and a recent utility bill to verify your address.

Security and Licensing

Security and player safety form the bedrock of operations at Godz Casino. We deploy military-grade 256-bit Secure Socket Layer (SSL) encryption protocol across all entry points, protecting your personal data, residential details, and financial transactions from unauthorized third-party access.

Our platform operates under a valid international gambling license issued by recognized regulatory authorities.
